sources.title: Morgana Build Guide : [26.19] Actioner's Morgana Support Guide⚡️

passive.name: Soul Siphon
passive.text: Morgana drains spirit from her enemies, healing as she deals damage to champions, large minions, and medium and larger jungler monsters.

spells.name: Dark Binding
spells.text: Morgana binds an enemy in place with dark magic, forcing them to feel the pain they've caused and dealing magic damage.

spells.name: Tormented Shadow
spells.text: Morgana casts a cursed shadow on an area, damaging enemies who dare stand in her dark circle. They receive magic damage over time, which increases the lower health they are.

spells.name: Black Shield
spells.text: Morgana anoints an ally with a protective barrier of starfire, which absorbs magical damage and disabling effects until it is broken.

spells.name: Soul Shackles
spells.text: Morgana unleashes the full force of her Celestial power as she unbinds her wings and hovers above the ground. She lashes chains of dark pain onto nearby enemy champions, gaining Move Speed. The chains slow and deal initial damage and, after a delay, stun those who are unable to break them.

damage.value: Morgana deals magic damage with Dark Binding as a single-hit burst.

archetype.value: Morgana is a support mage who uses dark magic to root enemies and protect with Black Shield.

axis.value: Morgana should poke while keeping the wave near the middle rather than pushing it needlessly.

winCondition.value: Morgana can turn a strong laning phase into a snowball by roaming and finding Dark Binding picks.

spikes.why: Morgana strengthens her most important ability by prioritizing it.

spikes.at: When Black Shield’s cooldown falls from 26 to 16 seconds
spikes.why: Morgana can shield an ally more often.

bait.why: Morgana loses her strongest tool for stopping a threat when Dark Binding is spent.
When Morgana spends Black Shield, its cooldown leaves her without that protection until it returns.

mistakes.value: Morgana makes a mistake by constantly pushing toward the tower without knowing where threats are.
